advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm no external consumer relies on the COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar `material_fingerprint` being the raw plan fingerprint (its value is now a composite hash); document the semantic change if the field is a public/queryable surface.
evidence: src/rebar/llm/completion_sidecar.py:485 `"material_fingerprint": material_fingerprint,` (was `material`) — now the composite from `_material_record`
tests/unit/test_audit_completion_v2.py:126 asserts `p["material_fingerprint"] != "fp"` (was `== "fp"`) — confirms the stored value changed

ABSENCE: grep of completion-sidecar `material_fingerprint` consumers shows only display-only reads (src/rebar/audit/page.py:159, src/rebar/_cli/_audit_commands.py:136) and completion_banking resolves its own via current_material_fingerprint (completion_banking.py:367,379) — NO equality/comparison consumer of the sidecar field, so no citable runtime break
advisory.finding: The durable COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar's `material_fingerprint` field changed value semantics: it previously carried the raw plan material fingerprint and now carries a 16-char composite short-hash (plan fingerprint + completion_read_basis + prefetch manifest). Any external tool that persisted or diffed prior sidecar `material_fingerprint` values against a plan fingerprint would see the value shape/meaning change, though no in-repo consumer compares it (all in-repo readers are display-only), so there is no runtime break.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test where completion_read_basis lacks receipt_digest and assert material_basis is unpinned (guarding the receipt_digest gate in _compact_completion_basis).
evidence: src/rebar/llm/completion_sidecar.py:107: `return {str(k): str(v) for k, v in out.items()} if "receipt_digest" in out else None`

Named violating input: build_payload on a FAIL verdict whose completion_read_basis omits receipt_digest (e.g. {'run_id':'r','code_oid':'a'*40,'tickets_oid':'b'*40}) — the added line returns None so material_basis becomes 'unpinned_completion_inputs' rather than pinned.

ABSENCE: tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py `_basis` always includes `receipt_digest`; the only unpinned test (test_unpinned_fail_payload_marks_material_basis) removes the whole completion_read_basis key, never the receipt_digest-missing case.
advisory.finding: No test exercises the added receipt_digest gating in _compact_completion_basis: a completion_read_basis dict that carries code_oid/tickets_oid/run_id but no receipt_digest is silently downgraded to the unpinned material_basis, and no test asserts this branch.
scenarios: A completion verdict carries a read basis with OIDs but a dropped/empty receipt_digest; the sidecar mislabels pinned material as unpinned undetected.

scenarios: A completion ERROR is emitted for a ticket with no resolvable plan material; the sidecar should omit material fields but the omission path is unverified.
